title: OrgGraph harvest specification
description: Normative gate artifact per provider (PRD FR-6.1c, E28, E31): source access, source-field-to-registry mapping, and crawl strategy, finalized from the source contract's harvestSpecDraft. phase-b-harvest.js is derived from this spec and references specVersion; phase B refuses to run if the referenced spec is missing, invalid, or version-mismatched.

provider.description: Canonical provider/source identifier (PRD E62): must equal the meta.source of every snapshot phase B emits; the phase B preflight verifies this.

specVersion.description: Version stamp referenced by phase-b-harvest.js (PRD E31).

registryVersion.description: Registry version the gate decisions were made against (PRD FR-6.1b).

basedOnAnalysis.description: runId of the source contract this spec was finalized from.

access.description: Source access: endpoints/selectors, navigation, and stable-id derivation (PRD FR-6.1c, FR-6.2).

mapping.description: Gate-confirmed mapping; carries ALL semantics (PRD FR-6.1c, E42) — nothing outside this mapping is exported, phase B adds only mechanics. Extraction rules are JSON paths, selectors, or templates as identified in the source contract.

scope.description: Scope the crawl declares (PRD FR-5.5, FR-6.6); edgeSources is filled at run time with the actually visited source ids.

traversal.description: Traversal order, e.g. "bfs from roots via children".

nodeMapping.description: One registry node type: how id, label, and props are derived from the source (PRD E42).

idFrom.description: Stable-id extraction rule (PRD FR-6.2); fallback ids must be namespaced <source>:<Typ>:<slug(label)> (PRD E41).

labelFrom.description: Label extraction rule (canonical display name, PRD FR-4.2b).

props.description: Target prop name -> extraction rule; scalar values only (PRD FR-4.5).

edgeMapping.description: One registry edge type: endpoint and prop extraction. Must cover every identityProp and reference prop (ref/implies) the registry declares for this type — the gate rejects specs with missing identityProps (PRD FR-6.1c, E42).

sourceFrom.description: Extraction rule for the source node id (subordinate side, PRD FR-7.2a).

targetFrom.description: Extraction rule for the target node id (superior/container side).

props.description: Target prop name -> extraction rule; includes identityProps and reference props (values are node ids).

observesTargetCompleteness.description: Gate-confirmed capability: this crawl fully observes the INCOMING edges of this type at visited target containers, so runtime edgeTargets entries for this edge type are a valid move-out proof (PRD FR-5.5a, E70). Without this flag the importer ignores edgeTargets entries of this type (warning, no closure).
